correctness.rationale: Confirmed exact positive Zumkeller summands, repetition permitted. Small Zumkeller 6,12,20 and 945 are verified from divisor equal-half subsets; no odd candidate <945 or between 945 and 971 meets necessary sigma(n)>=2n, by classification of odd prime-factor patterns. Using Somu-Kukla-Tran Proposition 4.6(a), every even N>=40 is a two-Zumkeller sum and 38 is not. Hence G_3=983=945+38 obstruction, while every N>=984 has a three-term sum. For k=4 even N>=980 are 6+6+two-sum, five consecutive odd numbers 981..989 have explicit four-term decompositions; 979 is obstructed. For any k>=4 odd obstruction T=6k+955 forces exactly one 945 and k-1 even terms with sum(y_i-6)=16, but y_i-6 is 0,6,14 only; impossible. Add 6 inductively to cover every integer above T. The finite verifier tests examples but does not prove the unbounded two-sum premise; that is explicitly imported from the published theorem.
